title: Sovereign AX selector hotfix v1
description: v1.3 (B-01, B-22, ADR-012). A hotfix may only (a) replace the `candidates` array of entries that are commits:false AND no secretKind AND inputType!=password AND closeAffordance!=true AND have no readbackOf AND no fieldKey, and (b) ADD commitEndpoints. role/namePattern/frame/landmark/expect/readbackOf/fieldKey/commits/commitEffect/secretKind/secretPurpose/closeAffordance/navigationOnly/allowedConstants have no key here, so the schema itself rejects them; the entry-eligibility conditions are checked by the engine against the target package's selectors.json AND its IR: an entry is NOT eligible if its stable_id is used as another entry's `landmark`, or if it is referenced by decide.scope, any condition (`cond`), signFlow.rowLabel, readback.fields, signFlow.confirmTarget, or by any step inside a commit window W(X) (E-03). Lookup packages (manifest.kind=lookup) are never hotfixed. After applying, the engine re-runs the schema and V-01..V-24 on (IR + patched selectors) and rejects the hotfix on any failure. SV-01..SV-06 run only in the registry hotfix CI (the 2-of-3 signatures presuppose a pass); at runtime the client enforces R-A1, R-A2 and DENY_ACTION_NAME on every actuation (design/03-engine.md §3.1-6, the canonical statement). Signatures: 2-of-3 distinct pinned keys over JCS(this object without `signatures`).

packageDigest.description: SHA-256 of the exact signed package (manifest contentDigests) this hotfix applies to. Any other package => reject.

expiresAt.description: Engine checks expiresAt - issuedAt <= 14 days; an expired hotfix is unloaded (package falls back to its own candidates).

commitEndpointsAdd.description: Strengthening only: appended to the portal commitEndpoints union. Removal or edit of existing commitEndpoints requires a full package release.
